end.summary:
Practised placing BCE and CE dates on a timeline.
Ordered 3000 BCE, 500 BCE, 100 CE and 1947 CE correctly after discussion.
Explored what a source shows, what it may leave out, and why historians cross-check.
Identified that both a ruler and an enemy may present a biased account.
end.parentNote: Asha practised timeline ordering with Aarav, including the rule that BCE years count down toward 1 BCE and CE dates move forward. Aarav first placed some BCE dates incorrectly, then gave the correct full order later in the lesson. They also discussed how a ruler’s account may leave out losses and how an opposing account can also be biased. At home, ask Aarav to arrange three BCE and two CE dates on paper and explain why each belongs in that position.
